display_name.zh: 多 Agent 开发调度器

description.zh: 多 Agent 编排器。支持多 Agent 并行开发、父子任务委托、消息传递和中断，使用 SQLite 持久化。
description.en: Multi-agent orchestrator. Supports parallel multi-agent development, parent-child task delegation, messaging, and interruption with SQLite persistence.

description.zh: 提供六个独立实现的协作接口，基于 SQLite Event Store 持久化。支持多 Agent 并行调度、父子任务委托、消息传递、中断和后续任务，含 request_id 幂等、副作用幂等和执行 epoch 恢复。全局最多 6 个活动 Run，单根最多 3 个。
description.en: Provides six independently-implemented collaboration APIs with SQLite persistence. Supports parallel multi-agent scheduling, parent-child task delegation, messaging, interruption, and follow-up tasks, with request_id idempotency, side-effect idempotency, and execution-epoch recovery. Global concurrency six, per-root three.

display_name.zh: 工具生命周期探针与文件网关

description.zh: 工具生命周期探针与文件网关。探针注册 hook 记录工具调用和 prompt compose 事件用于诊断。文件网关通过 prompt compose hook 按 Agent 身份裁剪可用工具列表，默认不限制，可按需注册白名单或黑名单。所有状态仅存于内存，重启后丢失。
description.en: Tool lifecycle probe and file gateway. The probe registers hooks to record tool-call and prompt-compose events for diagnostics. The file gateway filters available tools per agent identity via the prompt-compose hook; by default no tools are restricted, with optional allow/deny list registration. All state lives in memory and is lost on restart.
